Bill.BriefDescription: Including off-premises sales for holders of a beer and wine boutique and gift delivery license.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to beer and wine boutique and gift deliverylicenses; and amending RCW 66.24.550.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 66.24.550 and 1997 c 321 s 35 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There shall be a beer and wine retailer's license to be designatedas a beer and wine boutique and gift delivery license to solicit, takeorders for, sell for offpremises consumption, and deliver beer and/orwine in bottles and original packages. If the retailer offers deliveryservices, delivery must be made to persons other than the personplacing the order. A beer and wine boutique and gift delivery licensemay be issued only to a business ((solely)) primarily engaged in thesale or sale and delivery of gifts or wedding merchandise at retailwhich holds no other class of license under this title or to a personin the business of selling flowers or floral arrangements at retail.No minimum beer and/or wine inventory requirement shall apply toholders of beer and wine boutique and gift delivery licenses. The feefor this license is seventyfive dollars per year. Delivery of beerand/or wine under a beer and wine boutique and gift delivery license p. 1 SB 5111shall be made in accordance with all applicable provisions of thistitle and the rules of the board, and no beer and/or wine so deliveredshall be opened on any premises licensed under this title. A beer andwine boutique and gift delivery license does not authorize doortodoorsolicitation of gift wine delivery orders. Deliveries of beer and/orwine under a beer and wine boutique and gift delivery license shall bemade only in conjunction with gifts or flowers.
